response.sql: WITH per_product AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description AS ptd, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS cnt FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), with_share AS (SELECT ptd, avg_qty, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM per_product), per_type AS (SELECT ptd, AVG(avg_qty) AS a_qty, AVG(cnt) AS a_cnt, AVG(share) AS a_share FROM with_share GROUP BY ptd) SELECT AVG(a_qty) AS avg_quantity, AVG(a_cnt) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(a_share) AS avg_share FROM per_type
